description: NaV₃P₂O₁₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.84 Å. There are three inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.98 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.99 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.97 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are three shorter (1.55 Å) and one longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond length. There are thirteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two V atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one V atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom.
